note: Derived from OpenRouter's public MCP documentation, not from a signed-in tools/list. Names are verbatim; purposes are paraphrased. No input schema, output schema or annotation was published, so none is recorded. Never treat this file as a live capture.

tools.name: send-message
tools.purpose: Sends a message to a model and returns its reply, to test a prompt or compare models. Documented as billable inference; every reply includes the generation id.

tools.name: generate-image
tools.purpose: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns it inline as an image content block. Documented as billable inference.

tools.name: list-models
tools.purpose: Searches the live model catalogue with free-text search, sorting and filters.

tools.name: get-model
tools.purpose: Returns full details for one model by author/slug, with variant suffixes and aliases.

tools.name: list-model-endpoints
tools.purpose: Lists the providers that serve a model, with price, latency, throughput and data policy.

tools.name: list-providers
tools.purpose: Lists the providers available for routing preferences.

tools.name: list-daily-model-rankings
tools.purpose: Lists the most used and trending models by token volume.

tools.name: list-app-rankings
tools.purpose: Lists the apps that drive the most traffic, filterable by category.

tools.name: get-generation
tools.purpose: Returns cost, token counts and serving provider for one generation id.

tools.name: list-task-classifications
tools.purpose: Lists traffic market share by task type, with the top models for each.

tools.name: send-feedback
tools.purpose: Reports a problem with one of the account's own generations to OpenRouter's team. Documented as a write.

tools.name: spawn-ori-eval
tools.purpose: Returns instructions for running a model evaluation with Ori.

tools.name: install-ori-harness
tools.purpose: Returns the recipe for installing the Ori harness.

tools.name: ping
tools.purpose: Health check that verifies the connection.
